fields.description: Volunteer Nomination flow: who reviews an incoming volunteer nomination. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name (e.g. "grand regent"). Leave blank to fall back to the CentralOffice config, then settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.

Volunteer Nomination flow: who performs the vetting / reference check. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to CentralOffice, then settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.
Volunteer Nomination flow: who conducts the nominee interview. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to CentralOffice, then settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.

Volunteer Nomination flow: who administers/marks required training (CMT LMS + Vector CommunityEDU). Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to CentralOffice, then settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.

Volunteer Nomination flow: who confirms the nominee before appointment. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to CentralOffice, then settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.

Volunteer Nomination flow: who processes the final appointment (letter + chapter notification). Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to CentralOffice, then settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.

Central Office contact used as the default reviewer/denial actor for the Volunteer Nomination flow when a specific reviewer config is blank. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.
Award nomination flow: who approves award nominations. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to settings.EXECUTIVE_DIRECTOR.
Health & Safety education submission reviewer. Set to a username, email address, OR a national-officer role name. Blank falls back to the built-in default reviewer.
Slug of the Survey sent to graduating members. Set to the matching surveys.Survey slug.
Slug of the Survey sent to premature-alumnus / pre-alumn members. Set to the matching surveys.Survey slug.
Minimum active member count used in chapter status calculations. Set to a whole number (e.g. "10"). Blank keeps the built-in behavior.
URL to the group tax exemption form shown on the chapter detail page for chapters without a tax record. Set to the document URL.
HTML welcome message included in the pledge welcome email (rendered as HTML, not stripped). Set the rich-text welcome copy here.
Recipient list notified when a new job posting is created. Enter one or more email addresses separated by whitespace, comma, or semicolon.
Volunteer Nomination follow-up cadence: how many months to wait before re-contacting a nominee who asked to be contacted later. Whole number of months (default 6).

Link target for the "See something, say something" incident reporting section in the site footer. Paste the full https:// address of the Theta Tau Incident Report Form. Leave blank (or set a non http/https value) to hide the footer section entirely.
Transition Reports: how many days before an officer's term end date their transition report obligation is due. Whole number of days (default 14).
Transition Reports: comma-separated reminder offsets, in days relative to due_date. Positive = days before due; negative = days after due (past-due escalation). Default "21,14,7,1,-1,-7,-14".

Transition Reports: how many days before the current semester's end (core.models.semester_encompass_start_end_date) to send the generic broadcast reminder to everyone with an open obligation. Whole number of days (default 30).

Transition Reports: once a reminder offset at or below this value (days relative to due_date; negative = past due) is reached, the Regional Director is escalated in addition to the Regent. Whole number, normally negative (default -7).

Bigs and Littles: roles that may record, change and remove Bigs for their whole chapter and upload a CSV of pairings, in addition to the chapter officers. Comma-separated role names exactly as they appear on officer records (for example: pledge/new member educator, scribe). Blank means the New Member Educator only.

Chapter Support Specialists: who besides Admins may add specialists, assign their chapters and remove them. Usernames, emails or National Officer role names (for example: grand regent), one per line or comma separated. Blank means the Executive Director.
Chapter Support Specialists: slug of the inactive chapter that specialist accounts who are not members belong to. Blank means central-office. It must stay inactive.

Chapter Support Specialists: the chapter emails they get on CC as sent; every other one reaches them only in the daily digest. Kind codes, one per line or comma separated: officer_monthly, dues, workflow_update, workflow_escalation, award, nme_revision, bylaws, ballot, ballot_receipt, ballot_vote_removed, expulsion, disciplinary, officer_update, pnm_initiation, transition_past_due. 'none' sends everything through the digest. Blank means workflow_escalation, ballot, ballot_receipt, ballot_vote_removed, expulsion, disciplinary, officer_update and transition_past_due.

The date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which every National Officer must use two-factor sign-in. Until then, National Officers without it see a banner with the date. Blank means no requirement for National Officers. Admins and Chapter Support Specialists always need it.
